integrity.finite_tests: 308 orbit parameter cases; five directly assembled graphs with 2036 edges in total.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact dipole orbit recurrence, maximum principle, reversible moment identities, graph current count, and projector trace.
integrity.unproved_limits: No unrestricted projection-minimum result; finite checker is not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Real, unit-edge Johnson graphs J(n,k), n>=2k>=6; only Euclidean-orthogonal edge cut/cycle projections.
No claim about minimal norms over nonorthogonal projections, weighted graphs or non-endpoint exponents.
Literature novelty is subject to unindexed electrical-network results; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact cut–cycle endpoint norms on Johnson graphs and linear middle-slice amplification
